page.title: Poesie — Your personal space for poetry
page.translations: Translations of the Privacy Policy into other languages ​​will be available soon.
hero.title:
Every feeling,
written down.
hero.sub: Your personal, private space for poetry. Seamless sync, discreet encryption, and tools designed for writers.
hero.note: Your poems remain yours. Always — even offline.
feat1.heading: Write when inspiration strikes.
feat1.sub: Capture every line the moment it's born
feat1.text: Poesie offers a clean editor designed to stay in the background and leave space for your words. Choose from templates for haikus, sonnets, or free verse, set a timer for focused writing, and when words don't come, let the app give you a prompt.
feat1.item2: Templates for haikus, sonnets, and free verse
feat2.heading: Every collection, curated like a small book.
feat2.sub: Organize, distinguish, and find every poem
feat2.text: Create multiple collections by themes, moods, or projects. Add tags, bookmark your favorite poems, and choose a custom cover for each collection so you can recognize it at a glance in your library.
feat2.item2: Tags and filters to find every line
sec.heading: Private. Always protected.
sec.text: Every poem is protected by security designed for writers who write things they don't wish to share with anyone. Biometric lock or PIN upon opening, local encryption of your files, and complete storage flexibility: Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, or Local Only mode.
sec.card1_desc: The app opens only for you, via fingerprint, face unlock, or personal PIN.
sec.card2_desc: Your poems are securely stored on your device, fully encrypted.
sec.card3_desc: Sync to Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, or keep everything strictly on your device.
export.heading: Your words, ready for the world.
export.text: Turn your collections into a beautifully formatted PDF anthology, or export them to ePub, Markdown, or a webpage. For maximum privacy, a full encrypted ZIP backup is also available.
stats.heading: Watch your journey grow.
stats.sub: Streaks, annual statistics, and your Poetry Wrapped
stats.text: Track your daily streak, see how many poems you've written each month and year, and look back at your Poetry Wrapped at the end of the year: a small poetic summary of your progress.
stats.item3: Most used words in your verses
faq.title: Questions, asked in quiet
faq.a1: Your choice: in your Google Drive account, on Microsoft OneDrive, or exclusively on your device in Local Only mode. You decide where your poems reside.
faq.q2: Can anyone else read my drafts?
faq.a2: Only if you choose to share them. Your journal opens only for you.
faq.q3: Do I need a separate account?
faq.a3: No, no separate or proprietary account. You can connect your Google or Microsoft account for cloud sync, or use the app without any account in Local Only mode.
faq.q4: What if a poem is only half-written?
faq.a4: Leave it as it is. It will wait for you on its page until you're ready to return.
cta.heading: Start writing today.
cta.text: Poesie is free and available on Google Play. Your personal space for poetry is waiting for you.
footer.desc: A quiet space for your poetry. Write, protect, and export your verses in complete privacy.
